events.title: Duolingo Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on User Growth, Margin Gains
events.body: DUOL beat Q1 2026 EPS and revenue estimates as sales rise 27% to $292M; new speaking tools and AI-built content help lift users and bookings.

events.title: IT Q1 Earnings Beat on Contract Value Growth & Cost Control
events.body: Gartner beats Q1 EPS estimates as contract value rises and costs ease, lifting the 2026 EPS and free cash flow guidance despite lower revenues.

events.title: Innovations & Strategic Buyouts Aid Rollins Amid Integration Risk
events.body: ROL's growth rides on tech-driven efficiency and steady acquisitions. Its rising costs, integration risks and liquidity concerns could weigh on margins.

events.title: Broadridge Q3 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Increase Y/Y
events.body: BR posts Q3 earnings and revenue beat, driven by solid recurring revenue growth. The company raises its full-year EPS outlook.
